name: bedrock-bench
description: Plan agent experiments, benchmark real tasks, compare saved results, diagnose failures, audit graders, and explore charts and tool replays.

interface.longDescription: Run AWS CDK repair tasks, Terminal-Bench, SWE-bench, AWS-Bench, and starter benchmarks from chat. Design controlled experiments, compare matched tasks with uncertainty, diagnose recorded failures, and audit graders with reference and mutation checks. Browse saved runs, replay Harbor/Codex tools, and ask for charts or diagrams with evidence, cost coverage, and contextual follow-up prompts.
defaultPrompt: Run the AWS CDK reference smoke test.
Plan a Terminal-Bench model comparison on Bedrock.
Show the offline Bedrock Bench demonstration.
Browse my recent benchmark runs and replay the latest live run.
Plot cost versus success for my saved benchmark results.
Plan an experiment comparing the same model with and without an AWS skill.
